About the job
Norvale Consumer Group makes household and personal care brands sold in more than 30 markets. Our Global Business Services hub in Warsaw employs 1,100 people and supports finance, HR and supply chain processes for the whole group.

Over the next twelve months we will move the record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash activities of eleven European entities, including Germany, Austria and Switzerland, into the Warsaw hub. We are looking for an experienced contractor to lead this transition.

What you will do
- Lead the transition programme across three waves with a team of four transition managers
- Design the future process model, service catalogue, SLAs and KPIs together with the global process owners
- Plan and run knowledge transfer, parallel runs and stabilisation for each wave
- Align the processes with our S/4HANA single-instance template and the group accounting manual
- Make sure key controls (ICFR) keep working during and after the transition
- Support the ramp-up of around 60 new roles in Warsaw together with HR
- Report progress, risks and savings to the GBS Leadership Team and the CFOs of the entities concerned

What you bring
- 12+ years in finance, including at least three shared service or outsourcing transitions in a lead role
- Solid understanding of R2R, P2P and O2C processes and of the month-end close in a multinational group
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and process mining tools (e.g. Celonis)
- Lean or Six Sigma certification is an advantage
- Fluent English; German or Polish is a plus

Working model
This role requires full-time presence at our Warsaw hub, five days a week. Remote work is not possible for this assignment. The contract runs for twelve months and is set up as a B2B agreement with your own company or via our Polish contractor platform. Accommodation is not provided.

Norvale is an equal opportunity employer.
